operations.name: Harry Winitsky

expected.charges: Federal prosecution under the Espionage Act of 1917 and/or the Sedition Act of 1918.

updates.convicted: Yes — criminal anarchy conviction returned March 26, 1920
updates.judge: Weeks (New York Supreme Court sentencing judge)

operations.source: Contemporary March 27 and March 30, 1920 reports: https://www.historyworm.com/gazete/norwich_bulletin/1920-03-27/1 and https://www.historyworm.com/gazete/norwich_bulletin/1920-03-30/1 . Five-to-ten-year sentence imposed March 29 by Justice Weeks. Actual May 1922 release on bond confirmed in January 16, 1924 Daily Worker: https://www.marxists.org/history/usa/parties/cpusa/1924/0116-dw-winitskypardon.pdf . MONTH precision, no invented release day; pardon in 1924 is not release. Sentencing not assumed admission. Generic federal charge preserved/flagged.
